High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms. Sonali Soni - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Amit Bhagia - G.A. for the respondent / State.

Order 
This first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 18.3.2024 in connection with Crime No.162/24 registered at Police Station Mahu, District Indore for offence under Sections 363, 376 (2) (n), 506 of IPC and Section 51, 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

3. Since the prosecutrix is minor, therefore, no case is made out for grant of bail.
4.
Accordingly, application fails and is hereby dismissed.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26817 2 MCRC-39725-2024 JP Ritik Kohli vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99148665/
